# Blue Nest Montessori School

> Award-winning, Ofsted Good Montessori day nursery and preschool for children aged 3 months to 5 years in Harrow, Pinner and Borehamwood (new settings coming to Pinner Green and Northwood). We blend the authentic Montessori approach with the EYFS framework and weekly Forest School, and accept all government childcare funding.

Key facts:
- Ages: 3 months to 5 years
- Locations: Harrow (29 Churchfield Close, HA2 6BD), Pinner, Borehamwood; coming soon: Pinner Green, Northwood
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 7:30am–6:00pm, year-round
- Funding: 15 & 30 funded hours (3–4 yrs), 15 hours (eligible 2 yrs), funded hours from 9 months for eligible working parents
- Ofsted: Registered, rated Good. Award: Montessori School of the Year (London Prestige Awards)
- Contact: 020 8861 5574 · manager@bluenest.uk
